## Automated AI review

> **Community review:** Independent automated community review, unaffiliated with the Omarchy team, intended to help prepare PRs for their review.

**Verified:** Follow-up to the [earlier review](https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/pull/12833#issuecomment-5768241678), rechecked at `47eb31205df7` (the rebased single commit). No issue found in the package-selection scope. Both earlier points are settled:

| Earlier point (at `9141da7848be`) | Status at `47eb31205df7` |
| --- | --- |
| Nonstock library owners skip `libfprint-git`; fresh, stock and existing-git installs unchanged | Still verified |
| Optional test improvement: add a `libfprint-tod-git` owner case | Resolved |

**Verified (package selection):** The ownership check is unchanged since the earlier review. The only production difference is the base branch's `--` before the package targets, which pacman 7.1.0 accepts. Real pacman transactions with synthetic packages, parent `d3cfd53b997f` against this PR:

| Starting TOD state | Parent | This PR |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `libfprint-tod` only | Removes the fork noninteractively, installs `libfprint-git` | Keeps the fork; installs `fprintd usbutils` |
| `libfprint-tod` + vendor package | Refuses removal; setup aborts before enrollment | Keeps both; installs the tools |
| Same stack with both tools installed | Attempts the conflicting transaction; aborts | No transaction; reaches enrollment |
| `libfprint-tod-git` + vendor package | Refuses removal; setup aborts | Keeps both; installs the tools |

Fresh, stock `libfprint` and existing `libfprint-git` states still install `libfprint-git fprintd usbutils` in one transaction, with no transaction when `libfprint-git` and both tools are already installed.

**Verified (tests):** All 10 package tests pass, and the head tests reject the parent's code at the first TOD case. The hardcoded `libfprint-tod` mutation described in the earlier review now fails at the new case. That detection relies on the test's exact-name pacman stub: real `pacman -Q libfprint-tod` also matches packages that provide that name, which both AUR TOD forks do. The new case therefore pins the owner-based rule at the unit-test level.

**Optional test improvement:** The stub's `-Qqo` branch returns `LIBFPRINT_OWNER` without checking the queried path. A diagnostic mutation querying `/usr/lib/libfprint-2.so.1` passes all 10 cases, although on a system where that path is not package-owned the lookup would return no owner and bring back the `libfprint-git` replacement. Making the stub answer only for `/usr/lib/libfprint-2.so.2` (and exit 1 otherwise) would let the suite reject that mutation (suggested, not run).

---
